title: Not perfection. Belief.
paragraphs: Not perfection. Belief.
When I read the Bible, it often feels like I’m standing nearby, watching quietly…
The desert night is still. The stars stretch endlessly across the sky.
Abram looks up… listening to a promise that sounds almost impossible.
Descendants as countless as the stars.

No proof yet.
No visible future yet.
Just a choice.
And in that quiet moment… Abram believes.
Scripture says something astonishing:
God credited his belief as righteousness.
Standing there, hidden in the shadows, I realize something powerful…
God wasn’t asking Abram to be perfect.
He was asking him to trust.

Faith often begins exactly like this—
when we cannot see the outcome,
when fear whispers louder than hope,
when the promise feels bigger than our certainty.
Abram simply chose belief.
And that moment changed everything.
I am a witness, not a biblical character… yet this moment still speaks into my life today.
Where are you choosing belief over fear right now?
